correctness.rationale: Franklin graph F on 12 vertices consists of the 12-cycle plus even +5/odd −5 chords, 18 edges. Ind_2(F) is all vertex subsets with induced maximum degree <=1. Independently enumerated all 4096 masks, finding 722 legal nonempty faces with f=(12,66,184,264,168,28); the exact source vertex order produces 358 Morse pairs and six critical cells (one 0-cell, five 4-cells). The 2748 nonempty face-poset covers form an acyclic reversed-matching directed graph, proving X≃wedge5 S4 without relying only on homology. Independent NetworkX graph-isomorphism enumeration gives Aut(F) size48. Independently recomputed signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces, with multiset 5 once, −3 three times, −1 twenty times, +1 twenty-four times, sum0. The central shift z(i)=i+6 has character1, so +/- eigendim (3,2). The inspected exact group-character inner products are 1 for each central eigenspace, establishing absolute irreducibility; average trace 0 gives H4(X;Q)^G=0 and rational acyclicity of X/G by finite-group transfer. No integral quotient conclusion is inferred.
